# contentful_content_types (Data Source)

Reads all Contentful Content Types in an environment from the current CMA model, including unactivated draft changes. No snapshot is promised across pages. Alias routes require returned environment links to echo the requested alias ID; this Content Type behavior has not been verified live.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "contentful_content_types" "existing" {
  space_id       = var.contentful_space_id
  environment_id = var.contentful_environment_id

  lifecycle {
    postcondition {
      condition     = length([for content_type in self.content_types : content_type if content_type.name == "Article"]) == 1
      error_message = "Exactly one Content Type named Article is required."
    }
  }
}

locals {
  article = one([for content_type in data.contentful_content_types.existing.content_types : content_type if content_type.name == "Article"])
}

# Use local.article.content_type_id to address the selected Content Type.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment or environment alias used to address the collection. Mismatched returned environment links are rejected as unsupported response identity.
- `space_id` (String) ID of the Space used to address the collection.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `content_types` (Attributes List) Current CMA content types in returned order. Duplicate IDs are retained; an empty collection returns an empty list. Order is not promised across reads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_types))
- `id` (String) Composite Terraform lookup ID in `space_id/environment_id` form.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--content_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_types`

Read-Only:

- `content_type_id` (String) System ID of the content type.
- `description` (String) Current CMA description; null when omitted, and empty when explicitly empty.
- `display_field` (String) Current CMA display field ID; null when explicitly null, and empty when explicitly empty. The curated decoder rejects an omitted displayField.
- `fields` (Attributes List) Current CMA fields in returned order, including unactivated draft changes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_types--fields))
- `metadata` (Attributes) Current CMA annotations and taxonomy, or null when metadata is absent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_types--metadata))
- `name` (String) Current CMA name of the content type.
- `published_version` (Number) Most recently activated Contentful version, or null when never activated. This does not prove the returned fields match the activated version.

<a id="nestedatt--content_types--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_types.fields`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_resources` (Attributes List) Allowed resources for a Resource Link field, or null when absent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_types--fields--allowed_resources))
- `default_value` (String) Normalized JSON object of locale defaults, or null when absent.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the field is hidden in the entry editor, or null when absent.
- `id` (String) ID of the field within the content type.
- `items` (Attributes) Array item type and validations, or null for other fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_types--fields--items))
- `link_type` (String) Linked resource type for a Link field, or null when absent.
- `localized` (Boolean) Whether the field supports localized values, or null when absent.
- `name` (String) Name of the field.
- `omitted` (Boolean) Whether the field is omitted from Delivery and Preview responses, or null when absent.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether an Entry needs a value before publication, or null when absent.
- `type` (String) Contentful field type.
- `validations` (List of String) Ordered field validation rules as normalized JSON strings.

<a id="nestedatt--content_types--fields--allowed_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_types.fields.allowed_resources`

Read-Only:

- `contentful_entry` (Attributes) Allowed Contentful entry resource, or null for an external resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_types--fields--allowed_resources--contentful_entry))
- `external` (Attributes) Allowed external resource, or null for Contentful entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_types--fields--allowed_resources--external))

<a id="nestedatt--content_types--fields--allowed_resources--contentful_entry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_types.fields.allowed_resources.contentful_entry`

Read-Only:

- `content_types` (List of String) Allowed content type IDs.
- `source` (String) Source of the allowed Contentful entries.


<a id="nestedatt--content_types--fields--allowed_resources--external"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_types.fields.allowed_resources.external`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) External resource type.



<a id="nestedatt--content_types--fields--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_types.fields.items`

Read-Only:

- `link_type` (String) Linked resource type for Link items, or null when absent.
- `type` (String) Array item type, or null when absent.
- `validations` (List of String) Ordered array-item validation rules as normalized JSON strings.



<a id="nestedatt--content_types--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_types.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `annotations` (String) Normalized JSON annotations, or null when absent.
- `taxonomy` (Attributes List) Taxonomy concept and concept scheme links in returned order, or null when absent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_types--metadata--taxonomy))

<a id="nestedatt--content_types--metadata--taxonomy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_types.metadata.taxonomy`

Read-Only:

- `taxonomy_concept` (Attributes) Taxonomy concept link, or null for a concept scheme. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_types--metadata--taxonomy--taxonomy_concept))
- `taxonomy_concept_scheme` (Attributes) Taxonomy concept scheme link, or null for a concept. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_types--metadata--taxonomy--taxonomy_concept_scheme))

<a id="nestedatt--content_types--metadata--taxonomy--taxonomy_concept"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_types.metadata.taxonomy.taxonomy_concept`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Taxonomy ID.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether this association is required, or null when absent.


<a id="nestedatt--content_types--metadata--taxonomy--taxonomy_concept_scheme"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_types.metadata.taxonomy.taxonomy_concept_scheme`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Taxonomy ID.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether this association is required, or null when absent.
